iconicAnchor.label: Unicode Emoji sequences and modifiers
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Unicode defines emoji as pictographic symbols and specifies structured core, modifier, flag, tag, and joiner sequences that can behave as single grapheme clusters.

sources.title: Unicode Technical Standard #51: Unicode Emoji
supports: Emoji systems use defined characters, presentation styles, modifiers, and multi-code-point sequences to preserve interoperable meaning.

sources.title: Full Emoji Modifier Sequences
supports: Modifier sequences demonstrate how a base pictogram and structured variation operate as a coordinated token family across implementations.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches pictogram sequence, semantic combination, modifier logic, reaction chain, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/emoji-grammar/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
